text: Leo met Ariel, who was playing with friends near the plaza.

speaker: Ariel
text: Hi, Leo! How are you? I'm looking for the market. Do you know the way?

speaker: Ariel
text: I think the market is to the right. Am I right?

speaker: Ariel
text: No worries! I think the market may be around the next corner. Would you like to ask someone together?

speaker: Ariel
text: I'm doing well too, thanks! Do you know the way to the market?

speaker: Ariel
text: You're right! The market is to the right. Thanks for your help. It was nice meeting you!

speaker: Ariel
text: Oh, I was mistaken—the market is to the left. Thanks for correcting me! It was nice meeting you.
Ariel waved goodbye and headed off toward the market.

speaker: Ariel
text: Sure! Let's ask the vendor over there together.

speaker: Ariel
text: That's okay. I'll ask someone else. Thanks for chatting with me!

speaker: Ariel
text: It was nice meeting you too, Leo. Have a good day!

speaker: Ariel
text: You're welcome! I'm glad I could help.

speaker: Ariel
text: You're welcome! I hope you find the market.
